description.text: There are Entrance Examination before attending classes, arranged as follows: Science: Chinese, Math, English and Science comprehensive exam (Science Comprehensive exam includes: physics, chemistry and biology) Arts: Chinese, Math, English, Arts comprehensive exam (Arts comprehensive exam includes: Background of China and mordern world history)

duration.text: The Public Utilities Management at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3444 USD/per year ￥ 24800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 5 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Photocopy of valid passport(liaoning) 1. The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2. Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. An equivalent of China's high-school graduation certificate 2. High school graduation certificate and transcript 3. Be in good health 4. Over 18 years in age 5. A minimum requirement of HSK 5 or above certificate to prove your Chinese language ability Entry Exam Arrangement: Science: Chinese, Math, English and Science comprehensive exam (Science Comprehensive exam includes: physics, chemistry and biology) Arts: Chinese, Math, English, Arts comprehensive exam (Arts comprehensive exam includes: Background of China and mordern world history) Note: Mathematics result not included in the total score.
